title: proto-forge configuration
description: Merged over the built-in strict defaults and any ~/.config/proto-forge/config.json. Run `pnpm config:show` to see what is actually in force and where each value came from. Anything omitted keeps its strict default — this file only records deviations.

policy.description: Documentation of intent. Enforcement comes from gates[].mode and waivers[], not from this field.

gates.description: Per-gate settings. Tightening is always allowed. Relaxing a mandatory gate (i18n, testid, layer, docs, security, stub, consistency, snapshot) below "error" additionally requires a live waivers[] entry — without one, config:check fails AND the gate runs at "error" regardless of what is written here.

requireTranslated.description: Every locale must be actually translated, not merely present.

allowIdenticalToDefault.description: Permit values byte-identical to the default locale. Turning this on re-opens the copy-paste hole; prefer src/i18n/identical-ok.json for the handful of proper nouns that genuinely cannot differ.

failOnOrphanKeys.description: A catalogue key no code uses fails the gate.

failOnDynamicKeys.description: t(`x.${y}`) fails unless the file declares its key set with // i18n-dynamic:.

requirePluralCompleteness.description: Plural families must carry the categories the locale's grammar requires, per Intl.PluralRules.

scope.description: "semantic": interactive elements, headings, landmarks, list items, cells, media, form parts and anything with a role. "all" additionally requires layout wrappers.

requireUnique.description: Fail on the same static testid in two files.

requireScreenshots.description: Each documented subject needs a screenshot or an explicit <!-- no-screenshot: reason -->.

requireFreshScreenshots.description: A screenshot taken from older source than the current code fails. Re-run pnpm docs:shots.

dryRun.description: true (default) writes payloads to .proto-forge/outbox/ and contacts nothing. Live writes happen only via `pnpm sync:jira --commit`, never as a side effect of a pipeline phase.

createFor.description: Which pipeline events produce a ticket payload.

tokenEnv.description: Name of the env var holding the API token. Never the token itself.

requireApproval.description: Outward-facing effects an operator must confirm interactively, e.g. "jira.create", "confluence.publish".

protectedPaths.description: Glob patterns an agent hook refuses to edit — the byte-pinned seed, the locks, the append-only prompt log.

freezeThresholds.description: Refuse edits that would lower a coverage threshold or a budget ceiling. Overridable for one command with PROTO_FORGE_ALLOW_THRESHOLD_EDIT=1.

waivers.description: The only way to relax a mandatory gate. Each entry expires; after that the gate enforces again on its own.

reason.description: What the relaxation buys and why the risk is acceptable.

adr.description: Number of an ADR that exists in docs/adr/.

mode.description: error = fails the build. warn = prints findings and passes. off = does not enforce.
